arrays.name: Arrays
arrays.reason: Base topic. Everything else stores data in arrays.

recursion.name: Recursion
recursion.reason: Recursive problems on arrays/indices need array indexing first.

hashing.name: Hashing
hashing.reason: A hash table is built on an array and an index function.

sorting.name: Sorting
sorting.reason: Merge sort and quick sort are recursive.

searching.name: Binary Search
searching.reason: Binary search works only on sorted data.

linked_list.name: Linked Lists
linked_list.reason: Learned by comparing with arrays (node vs index).

stacks.name: Stacks
stacks.reason: Built using an array or a linked list.

queues.name: Queues
queues.reason: Built using an array or a linked list.

memoization.name: Memoization
memoization.reason: Stores recursive results in a hash map.

dp.name: Dynamic Programming
dp.reason: DP is recursion plus saved sub-results.

backtracking.name: Backtracking
backtracking.reason: Tries choices recursively and undoes them.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.reason: Most greedy problems start by sorting.

trees.name: Binary Trees
trees.reason: Nodes with links; traversals are recursive.

bst.name: Binary Search Trees
bst.reason: A tree that follows the binary search idea.

heaps.name: Heaps
heaps.reason: A complete binary tree stored in an array.

graph_rep.name: Graph Representation
graph_rep.reason: Adjacency list/matrix use arrays and lists.

bfs_dfs.name: BFS / DFS
bfs_dfs.reason: BFS uses a queue, DFS uses a stack or recursion.

shortest_paths.name: Shortest Paths
shortest_paths.reason: Dijkstra uses a heap on top of graph traversal.
